schoolName: Université Abdou Moumouni — Faculté des Sciences de la Santé
reviewNotes: HOLD — UAM's official enrolment page gives a Faculty of Health Sciences fee line (200,000 FCFA for years 1–6 and 400,000 FCFA for year 7), but it does not identify the award, specify whether these rates apply to international students, or supply a current medicine admissions route, deadline, language, programme curriculum, clinical placement plan or accommodation support. WDOMS records a public, currently operational French-language seven-year Docteur en Médecine programme, but directory information is not a substitute for a current university admissions and fee source. A primary-source medicine page and international terms are needed before writing public content.

sources.label: UAM official enrolment page
sources.notes: Lists FSS fees: 200,000 FCFA for first to sixth year and 400,000 FCFA for seventh year; general dossier selection occurs within each faculty. It does not distinguish international tuition or explain a medicine-specific route.

sources.label: UAM Campus Niger enrolment portal
sources.notes: Provides online registration/payment activity for UAM, but no current FSS medicine programme requirements or fee specification.

sources.label: World Directory of Medical Schools — UAM FSS
sources.notes: Lists public, currently operational school; Docteur en Médecine; seven years; French language. It must not be used alone for current admissions, tuition or licensing claims.

sources.label: UAM official FSS history item
sources.notes: A 2025 UAM item corroborates the Faculty of Health Sciences' role in Niger medical education and its association with CHU Lamordé; it does not document a current student clinical-placement arrangement.
